_what: Page routes under /work/api answered by running one Workshop tool (src/workspace_domain.rs OwnerRoutes, the family `family`; its owner is src/local_workspace.rs ReadInput::WorkshopRoute, run by src/tool_runs/page_routes.rs). Each row is {methods, exact, prefix, tool}: a request whose method is one of `methods` and whose path (after /work/api) is one of `exact` or starts with one of `prefix` is answered by running `tool` (an ai-tool-descriptor row of the account's installed Workshop, never one of the engine's own rows) for the page's account, through the same run a page's POST /work/api/door/tools:run takes (a row that declares records gets its pass from the page's own session, src/account_rights/run_cause.rs). The tool's input is {path, method, query, body, browser, account_id}: `account_id` the page's admitted account, set by the engine when it runs the tool (src/tool_runs/page_routes.rs with_account, Round 2 contract B), over anything the request held; `path` the route after /work/api without its query, `query` the query's names and values (the last value of a repeated name, as Object.fromEntries(URLSearchParams) reads it), `body` the JSON body or {} (a write, any method but GET, is let in only from the page's own origin: workspace_domain.rs guard, the old application src/change-from-elsewhere.mjs, so a request from another site is refused 403 before the tool runs) and `browser` the asking browser's own {user_agent, origin, visitor}. The tool's result (its row's result_selector, `$.result`) is {status, body}: the page is answered `status` with `body` as JSON. A run under the page's own idempotency-key when it carries one, else under a fresh random key, as the old application src/own-resource-compatibility.mjs execute() ran a route command (key ?? crypto.randomUUID()). These rows are matched before every row of src/server/owner-routes.json. A row may also name `root` paths: a request at the site's root for one of them, by one of the row's methods, is that route under /work/api with its query (src/workspace_domain.rs workshop_root_target, moved first in src/workspace.rs dispatch_admitted, then admitted and signed in like the route itself), for an address an outside service already holds from before the routes lived under /work/api; a root path is never under /work. Rows are added by the integrator from what each Workshop route tool's lane reports.
